course.title: Programing Techniques
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: The Dept. of MSE, KUET has decided to keep track of all 240 students enrolled in the (14) department. Roll number, Name, E-mail, Mobile number, CGPA, and Year of enrollment will be considered while storing the students' information.
i) Write a function that will take the 'Roll number' as a parameter and print all the stored information of that student.
ii) Write a function that will take the ‘Year of enrollment' as a parameter and print all the students who had enrolled on that particular year in the MSE dept.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
